point: Lantern extracts structured fields from supplier invoices with an LLM.
src: prep:L13 | "an LLM pipeline that extracts structured fields from supplier invoices"
point: It cut manual entry from 11 minutes to 2 minutes per invoice.

point: It ran on 38,000 invoices a month.
src: prep:L14 | "ran on 38,000 invoices a month"
deep: Lantern was an LLM pipeline that turned supplier invoices into validated structured data. A small model
 handled the first pass and a larger one only low-confidence documents. Fields below 0.8 confidence went to a
 human operator, about 7 percent of invoices, and every prompt change was checked against a frozen set of 400 invoices.
src: prep:L19 | "Low-confidence fields (below 0.8) go to a human operator"
src: prep:L26 | "a frozen set of 400 invoices"
@END
